scenes.label: scene1-turn
scenes.prompt:
Japanese anime-style cinematic scene, moody blue-and-neon night palette, heavy atmospheric rain. A teenage boy stands at a rooftop's edge, his necktie whipping in the wind, gazing out over the glowing city skyline. In the lit stairwell doorway behind him stands the faint, translucent figure of a girl, silent and still, watching him.

Timeline:
[0.0-3.0s] Rain intensifies; he keeps staring outward, unaware of the presence behind him. Slow push-in.
[3.0-6.0s] The stairwell light flickers; his eyes narrow, sensing something.
[6.0-9.0s] He slowly turns his head over his shoulder toward the doorway.
[9.0-12.0s] His body follows; the girl tilts her head, the light around her warming from cold white to soft gold.
[12.0-15.0s] He has turned three-quarters toward her; she lifts one hand toward him. Hold on this suspended moment.

Camera: one continuous slow push-in, no cuts.
Audio: heavy rain, distant thunder, a single sustained piano note.
No 3D look, flat cel-shaded anime, no text overlays.

scenes.label: scene2-reunion
scenes.prompt:
Continuing directly from the previous shot, same two characters and setting. The boy finishes turning to face the girl; a gust of wind sweeps the rooftop as heavy rain begins to slow unnaturally, droplets hanging in midair.

Timeline:
[0.0-4.0s] He steps toward the doorway; she steps out to meet him, her form growing warmer and more solid.
[4.0-9.0s] The distant skyline softens into warm white-gold light; the suspended raindrops drift slowly upward.
[9.0-12.0s] The two reach toward each other, fingertips almost touching; a soft warm light blooms outward.
[12.0-15.0s] Wide final shot: the skyline fades to soft white-gold light; the two figures soften and dissolve into it together, calm and at peace.

Camera: continues the same slow push-in into a gentle pull-back for the final reveal.
Audio: rain fades to silence; the piano note resolves into a warm major chord swell.
No 3D look, flat cel-shaded anime, consistent with the previous shot.
